Title: Unmanaged Azure Active Directory accounts update for March 2021

Body.Content:
Beginning March 31, 2021, Microsoft will no longer support the redemption of invitations by creating unmanaged Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) accounts and tenants for B2B collaboration scenarios.

In preparation for this, we encourage you to opt into email one-time passcode authentication.
